_comment: Pre-registered rules. Written and committed before any NISAR value was inspected (2026-11-15). Sliders in the page may vary weights to show sensitivity; the headline result always uses these values.

truth._note: Truth (UNOSAT 4257 outline if obtainable, else the USGS source point) is used only to score, never to rank.

offsets.background: subtract median over the box of quality pixels
offsets.noise_estimate: 1.4826 * MAD of fall-line motion over non-glacier pixels with slope < 20 deg

score.formula: (motion/sigma) * dir_coherence * (opposing_bonus if opposing_sign) * (ice_bonus if ice_over_rock) * (1 + w_pop*log10(1+people_below)) * (1 + w_season*(season_anomaly-1))

pass_condition.rule: a blob within 2 km of the source and in the same catchment ranks top 5 in BOTH of the last two ascending windows before 26 Aug
pass_condition.baseline: rank by mean raw offset magnitude alone
